messages:
maria: heads up — I pushed the default-deny egress rule to eu-west-1 VPCs at ~10:08. Immediately saw keystore proxy errors and GPU nodes failing to join. anyone on call?
jonathan: yup, provisioning stuck. keystore decrypt timeouts and AccessDenied when trying to fetch keys. sample from node bootstrap: 
```
keystore-proxy error: decrypt timeout: context deadline exceeded
node-provision: attach-kms-key failed: AccessDenied: User cannot decrypt CMK
```
ops-bot: [ALERT] keystore-proxy-3 restarted 3x in last 5m, audit-exporter QPS spike detected (1200r/s) :rotating_light:
kevin: audit-exporter is emitting full-line audit events to our SIEM. With default-deny some retries are clogging egress path -> natgw conntrack + logging bandwidth. cost + throttles.
sre-jen: we should either throttle audit export (sample) or temporarily allowlist keystore endpoints. rolling firewall back across whole region will be noisy. thoughts: short rollback to previous fw + a staged tighten while we tune sampling.
security: we cannot drop audit collection entirely. sampling is ok if documented and reversible. need approval from compliance before any >24h exception. we can do a short emergency rollback (30m) while we flip sampling to 10% and tag events with "emergency-sampled".
andrew: agree with short rollback. also want an IAM check — some nodes report AccessDenied, likely because we tightened role-boundary/condition earlier this week. rollback + allowlist might mask the real IAM regression. can we confirm whether key policy change landed around same time?
maria: good call — I reverted the fw change for the compute subnets at 10:14 (partial rollback). watching node joins now. please don't stop me if compliance says no: this is a 15–30m window.
jonathan: provisioning recovering, 6/8 retrying nodes now reached Ready. still seeing ~30% audit event dupes hitting exporter.
kevin: switching exporter to sampling=10% now. patch: 
```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: audit-exporter-config
data:
  sampling: "0.1"
```
applied in staging -> monitoring.
sre-jen: if sampling holds, we'll plan a canary reapply of tighten rules in one AZ with stricter conntrack/timeouts. also propose increasing natgw scaling to absorb bursts.
security: noted. create a PR with the sampling rationale and timeline. compliance needs the audit trail preserved (store raw events in cold bucket with 90d retention).
andrew: I'll audit the IAM/keystore policy diffs now and flag any role-condition changes. assigning to myself, will report in 15.
ops-bot: [DEPLOY] audit-exporter config patched in eu-west-1 at 10:22 by kevin (change-id: cfg-6881).
maria: thanks all. immediate plan: 1) keep partial rollback for 30m, 2) sampling 10% live, 3) natgw scale up by 2x for 1h, 4) andrew to validate key policy, 5) postmortem + compliance PR by EOD. please ack. :thumbsup:
jonathan: ack — monitoring node join and keystore error rate.
kevin: ack — rolling metrics, cost/ingest dashboard pinned.
sre-jen: ack — will run AZ canary after we confirm stable.
security: ack (compliance loop aware).
andrew: ack — will post IAM diff in 10m.
